messages:
maria: Morning — async check-in (what I did / blockers / today)
- Did: landed the sticky-routing rule + canary rollout, ran smoke tests against auth-proxy.
- Blocker: hitting intermittent 429 -> 502 chain when clients retry after rate-limit; nginx reports upstream 502 and we see a negative X-Rate-Limit-Remaining in headers on some requests. Also need a quick PR review for ingress-config#412 (routing policy precedence).
- Today: pair with Ajay to trace the 502 path, finish the PR review, update the runbook if we find a mitigant.

ajay: saw the same on staging earlier. grabbed logs — looks like a race between policy broadcast and the router kv cache invalidation. when a request hits mid-update we sometimes return 429, client retries immediately, then upstream chokes and becomes 502.
Could you add router debug logs (ENABLE_ROUTER_DEBUG=1) and try repro with the script? quick grep I ran: `rg "502|x-rate-limit|kv-cache" /var/log/gw/*.log`

maria: repro curl I used (use the rot-test token):
```
curl -i -X POST https://gw.staging.redwood/api/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rot-test-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","client_id":"test-client","simulate_rate":true}'
```
This forces the client-side retry path. paste any 502+headers you see.

kate: I'm blocked on jwt rotation tests failing the canary. failures look authz-filter related — the filter chain order changed after the routing rule rollout? Not sure if it's the same race but overlaps timewise. I can flip the policy broadcast to a slow path for a quick test. I'll open a tiny PR to test a 5s stagger.

simon: I'll pick up the ingress-config#412 review and the rules-transactor change if Kate opens it. Plan B: if we can't stabilize today I'll revert the sticky routing rollout to avoid the race and roll a clamp into the envoy filter to never return negative remaining.

ops-bot: deploy event: canary deploy started by maria — gw-service v1.13.2 -> canary (7001234600).

maria: thx — tagging @simon @ajay @kate. Simon, ping me when you start the review. Ajay, once you have logs please paste the snippet (headers + error lines). I'll update the runbook with reproducer and temporary mitigation (clamp remaining to 0) after we confirm.

ajay: quick paste from staging logs showing the odd header (redacted):
```
[2026-03-18T14:45:22Z] request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 upstream_msg="bad gateway" x-rate-limit-remaining=-1
[2026-03-18T14:45:22Z] kv_cache_miss key=policy:client:test-client
[2026-03-18T14:45:22Z] retry_attempt=1 client_retry_after=0.2
```

kate: opened rules-transactor#58 to add an optional stagger on broadcast (guarded by env var TRANSACTOR_STAGGER_MS). small change, unit tests included. putting the link in the PR description to the reproducer.

simon: ACK, reviewing both PRs now (ingress-config#412, rules-transactor#58). if both LGTM I'll queue a canary patch. if not green by EOD I'll open the hotfix to clamp negative remaining (ingress-filter#fix-clamp).

maria: SGTM. If you test locally, use token `rot-test-01` and the curl above. I'll follow up here with runbook edits and a short postmortem if we had to roll back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
